rules.statement: A party cannot compel the other party to give evidence on their behalf in a civil suit, as per section 120(1) of the Evidence Ordinance read with the second proviso to section 175(1) of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "I therefore cannot agree with the contention that section 120 (1) of the Evidence Ordinance read with the second proviso to section 175 (1) of the Civil Procedure Code enables one party to compel the other party to give evidence."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 120(1) of the Evidence Ordinance and the second proviso to section 175(1) of the Civil Procedure Code
